svg.aria-label: Rev B component layout: the 24 VAC entry, rectifier, reservoir and TMR 12-4811WI converter on the EXT board's mid field with a USB-C pigtail to the Pi, a 7-way GH link at the opening carrying VS and COM to the INT board, and the INT board with its power section removed.

g.text: Rev B: the Pi's supply lives on the EXT board, component side up, scale 8 px per mm
Grey: carried over from rev A. Orange: new part. Dashed grey: rev A part that leaves. Hatched: keep clear. The panels sit as the boards do in the enclosure, the opening between them.
PTSM faces 1.55 mm inside the edge, pin row 6.95 (Phoenix positions)
J4.1 and J4.2 become channel positions
no parts: the Pi's USB stacks sit under this field
Pi powered by USB-C from EXT; header pins 2 and 4 carry nothing
silkscreen, component side: ring 0.35, letters 0.8 filled, gap 0.35, caps 1.45 mm
H faces 1.7 mm outside the edge
EXT: 24 VAC enters on J3, a 2-way PTSM at the bottom edge, through F1 (1.1 A PTC) into the D1-D4 bridge and C3 (470 uF 63 V).
That rail, VS and COM at about 35 V, feeds U3 (TMR 12-4811WI, isolated) whose 5.1 V goes to J4, a 2-pin JST XH, and from there by a
USB-C pigtail to the Pi's own USB-C inside the enclosure; header pins 2 and 4 carry nothing, so the Pi's input protection stays.
INT: the bridge, F1, C1 and J7 leave. J4.1 and J4.2 become channel positions. VS and COM for the twelve sense channels arrive
over the link, which grows from five ways to seven: GH SM07B-GHS-TB side entry on INT facing the slot, BM07B-GHS-TBT top entry on EXT.
J1 sits at EXT's left edge beside the opening, low against the rib so it clears INT's J6; the only keep-out is the room for its plug and a
finger. The rest of the mid field carries the power section; the riser field is not reserved. The probe end stays as rev A.
Heights: the housing gives EXT at least 30 mm everywhere (measured 2026-09-26), so C3 (25 mm) and F1 (13 mm) stand and U3
(12 mm) is unconstrained. Creepage: 2 mm between the VS/COM copper and the Pi-side copper; U3 provides the 1.6 kV barrier.
Pigtail: a power-only USB-C plug with two 22 AWG leads; the Pi 4 takes 5 V on VBUS with no CC negotiation. J3's plug does not fit J4.
C3 at 470 uF holds the valley near 28 V at the Pi's 0.4 A peak against U3's 16.4 V lockout; 3 V of ripple at the 0.16 A typical.
Ratings: J3 6 A 160 V; GH 1 A 50 V per contact against 37 V on VS; XH 3 A against a 1.5 A Pi peak; F1 holds 1.1 A at 0.45 A.
INT: with the power strip empty, U1-U3 and R1-R12 shift 4.5 mm right, so the J9 breakout pads beside the header get 6.7 mm of clear board.
